query: INSERT INTO staff_suggestion_events (org_id, branch_id, suggestion, employee_id, on_date, accepted, decided_by, work_shift_id, source) SELECT $1, b, $2, $3, $4, true, $5, $6, 'manual' FROM ( SELECT COALESCE(ws.branch_id, ( SELECT eb.branch_id FROM employee_branches eb WHERE eb.employee_id = $3 ORDER BY eb.assigned_at LIMIT 1)) AS b FROM work_shifts ws WHERE ws.id = $6 AND ws.org_id = $1) x WHERE b IS NOT NULL
